sources.title: Fruitafossor windscheffeli, holotype LACM 150948
sources.authors: Zhe-Xi Luo and John R. Wible; image processing by Jessie Maisano
sources.supports: Holotype identity, approximately 150 Ma Morrison Formation occurrence, incomplete skull and about 40 percent of the postcranial skeleton, scratch-digging forelimbs and xenarthrous lumbar articulations.
sources.verification: Preparation read the expert annotation. Preparation and maker visually inspected the actual CT thumbnail. Its low resolution does not independently establish fine claw anatomy.
sources.rights: UTCT DigiMorph copyright. Private research reference only. Not embedded or redistributed. No CT mesh was downloaded or used.

sources.title: A Late Jurassic Digging Mammal and Early Mammalian Diversification
sources.authors: Zhe-Xi Luo and John R. Wible
sources.supports: Author-uploaded original figure caption and contextual paragraphs describe a complete forelimb/manus, powerful muscle insertions, shortened robust metacarpals, broad flattened near-spatulate terminal claws with non-bifid apices.
sources.verification: Preparation read the original author-uploaded caption and contextual paragraphs. The original figure image request timed out and is not claimed as visually inspected. A PDF mirror returned HTML and was not used.
sources.rights: AAAS and original authors retain rights. Factual anatomical descriptions only; no original paper image is embedded or redistributed.

sources.title: Fruitafossor windscheffeli skeletal reconstruction
sources.author: Scott Hartman
sources.supports: Author's skeletal reconstruction, stated 16 cm total length with a 2 cm scale, relative head/trunk/tail proportions and robust forelimb construction.
sources.verification: Preparation downloaded and inspected the full image. Maker re-inspected it before modeling. This is a reconstructed skeleton, not the entire preserved holotype. The 16 cm figure is a reconstruction estimate, not a measured complete fossil body length.
sources.rights: Copyright Scott Hartman. Private research reference only; no image, traced silhouette, texture or mesh is embedded or redistributed.

original_work: Geometry is generated from original semantic profile lofts and measured design parameters. No third-party mesh, traced outline or reference image texture is used.
uncertainty: Coat, coloration, external ears, completed tail, exact stance and soft-tissue volume are artistic restoration choices. No claim of preserved soft tissue or resolved mammalian phylogeny is made.
